main_text.head: In Messem Philosophicam
Clari Philosophi,
M. GERARDI de VRIES, Prof. Publ.
main_text.p: ALba dies, rumpunt quando granaria messem, Et grata tellus insitum cum fænore Reddit multijugo, conclamant Euge! coloni, Redit labori præmium dignum Deo.
Non secus incoctum generoso pectus honesto Divina concipit, ferunt quæ sæculum Judiciumque Virûm limatum, fæce rejectâ Vagæ, superbæ, turbidæ scientiæ.
Assiduis volvit curis, altumque revolvit, Remotiora sensibus dictamina;
Donec parturiens in dias luminis auras Laudanda promat pluribus Certamina.
Applaudunt Docti, Studiosaque densa corona Plaudit, beatam se videns fœtu novo.
Ominor hoc fatum (nec sim tibi vanus Aruspex) Elucubratæ & eruditæ paginæ.
Nec satis: in reliquum diffundet se labor orbem. Spe vanidâ vel circuitionibus
Non avidum fallet Lectorem, sed melioris Veri replebit corda succo, sanguine:
Doctior ut redeat, maturior Orbis Epoptes, Dei, Sui, Soli, Poli Consultior.

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "A" is decorative and is shown joined to "Lba" as the first word of the stanza. The line "Non secus incoctum..." is set as a verse stanza; line breaks are kept within each paragraph as printed.
